clarification_question: There are two blue cubes visible. Should I manipulate the one in the foreground or the one in the background?
goal_interpretation: Identify the specific blue cube intended for manipulation (as there are two), grasp it, transport it over the transparent box, place it inside, and release it to ensure it rests within the container boundaries.

nodes.description: Initial scene with two blue cubes and one transparent box on the table.
observable_conditions: Two blue cubes visible on the left
One transparent box visible on the right
unknown_conditions: Which blue cube is the specific target
Exact weight and friction of the blue cubes
Internal dimensions of the transparent box

nodes.description: Determine which blue cube to manipulate based on task context or default selection.
observable_conditions: Visual distinction between front and back cubes
unknown_conditions: User preference if not specified by position

nodes.description: Robot arm approaches and grasps the selected blue cube.
Move the held cube horizontally and vertically to align over the transparent box opening.
unknown_conditions: Depth perception accuracy through transparent material

nodes.description: Lower the cube into the box and open the gripper to release it.
observable_conditions: Cube contact with box bottom or sides

nodes.description: Confirm the blue cube is successfully inside the transparent box and released.
observable_conditions: Cube visually contained within box boundaries

objects.description: Blue cube located in the foreground left of the table.
Blue cube located behind the front blue cube.
Transparent rectangular container located on the right side of the table.

physical_checks: Verify the selected blue cube is within reachable workspace bounds.
Check if the transparent box opening is large enough to admit the cube.
Assess grip force required to prevent slipping without crushing.
Validate that the placement trajectory avoids clipping the box rim.
Confirm the box is stationary and heavy enough not to tip during insertion.
